introduction_raw:
The battery is necessary for the JBL Charge 4 to power up and work properly. It also is responsible for charging your phone when connected to the USB out port. If you notice decreased battery life your battery may be dying.  This guide will show you how to replace the battery in your JBL Charge 4.

The steps are about the same for the Charge 4Q but the battery is not the same here you need a battery that is offered for Charge 4Q and the Charge 5 it does use 3.6V
